session_label: Patna Madrasa Sulaimania MS no. 2 acquisition and intake packet
scope: Operational packet for acquiring and evaluating the Patna Madrasa Sulaimania MS no. 2 / For Tomorrow no. 126 Divan-i Haqiqi lead. This file does not promote the item to data/witness_register.json and does not change witness counts.

candidate.holding_reported: Madrasa Sulaimania / Sulaymaniyah, Patna, India, manuscript no. 2
candidate.facsimile_series: Majma-i Zakhair-i Islami For Tomorrow / Baray-i Farda no. 126
candidate.critical_ambiguity: The 126-page listing is not a folio count and does not identify the author. It cannot be treated as a Cihansah witness until the catalogue entry or facsimile gives author-heading, incipit/explicit, colophon, first lines, or other identity evidence.

acquisition_routes.ask: Request the 2023 Patna catalogue entry for manuscript no. 2 and the For Tomorrow no. 126 facsimile pages, not just purchase metadata.
Ask whether the Boroujerdi Library can provide or broker the catalogue entry and facsimile pages for scholarly verification.
Use OCLC 1402253747 and ISBN 9786223041525 to locate a holding library or request scans of the entry for manuscript no. 2.
If publisher routes fail, contact Madrasa Sulaimania Library or a Patna/Bihar manuscript researcher for title-page, first-folio, final-folio, and catalogue-entry images.

minimum_evidence_request: Catalogue entry for Madrasa Sulaimania Patna manuscript no. 2.
Facsimile title page or first page showing title and any author heading.
Incipit and explicit, preferably photographed or transcribed.
Foliation or page/leaf count, distinguishing printed facsimile pages from manuscript folios.
Colophon, date, scribe, ownership notes, and seals if present.
At least three poem opening lines or first bayts for comparison against known Cihansah witnesses.
Any catalogue note identifying the author as Cihansah/Jahanshah/Cahan Shah, Qaraqoyunlu/Karakoyunlu/Turkman, or another Haqiqi.

promote_to_register_candidate_if: The entry or manuscript explicitly identifies the author as Cihansah/Jahanshah/Cahan Shah Haqiqi with Qaraqoyunlu/Karakoyunlu/Turkman lineage.
Or the first lines/contents match known Cihansah corpus witnesses closely enough to exclude a generic Haqiqi homonym.
hold_outside_register_if: The only evidence remains the title Divan-i Haqiqi plus Patna MS no. 2.
The entry gives Persian-only poetry without author identity, first lines, date, or contextual markers.
The facsimile or catalogue title appears publisher-normalized and is not visible on the manuscript itself.
reject_as_non_cihansah_if: The entry identifies another author using Haqiqi as takhallus.
The text is a Sufi treatise, prose work, or local Persian/Urdu corpus unrelated to Cihansah's Persian-Turkish divan.
First lines match another known Haqiqi or a non-Cihansah work.

contact_template.subject: Request for Patna Madrasa Sulaimania MS no. 2 / Baray-i Farda no. 126 verification images
body: I am verifying a manuscript lead listed as Divan-i Haqiqi, manuscript no. 2, Madrasa Sulaimania, Patna, India, published as Baray-i Farda / For Tomorrow no. 126 by Majma-i Zakhair-i Islami.

Could you provide the catalogue entry for manuscript no. 2 from the 2023 catalogue Fihrist-i nuskha-ha-yi khatti-i kitabkhana-yi Madrasa-yi Sulaimania, Patna, Hindustan (ISBN 9786223041525; OCLC 1402253747), and, if possible, images from the For Tomorrow no. 126 facsimile?

The key verification points are: author heading, title as written on the manuscript, incipit, explicit, foliation/page count, colophon/date/scribe, and several poem opening lines. These details are needed only to determine whether this Haqiqi is Jahanshah/Cihansah Qaraqoyunlu or another Haqiqi.
